page_title: LEN 2-0 NIC | Lens v Nice 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Adrien Thomasson as he is replaced by Andrija Bulatovic (Lens).

90+2' Lens slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' What a sweet touch by Adrien Thomasson (Lens) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Yehvann Diouf to hold.
88' Matthieu Udol (Lens) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rayan Fofana (Lens) comes onto the pitch so that Odsonne Edouard can be given a rest.
83' Salis Abdul Samed (Nice) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
83' The fouls committed statistics – 13:11.
80' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
78' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) replaces Florian Thauvin.
78' Today's match ends for Wesley Said who will be replaced by Florian Sotoca (Lens).
77' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
77' Florian Thauvin (Lens) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
76' Wesley Said (Lens) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

75' Tiago Gouveia (Nice) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
74' A player from Nice commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Lens have a free kick.
73' The ball goes out for a corner. Nice can continue in their attacking effort.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tiago Gouveia (Nice) comes onto the pitch for Isak Jansson.
70' Substitution. Hicham Boudaoui walks off the pitch and Salis Abdul Samed (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
70' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) replacing Morgan Sanson.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ali Abdi (Nice) for Kojo Peprah.
69' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
69' The ball is out of play. Lens will take a throw-in.
68' Total attempts – 8:7.
66' Florian Thauvin (Lens) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
64' Half-chance! Ruben Aguilar (Lens) plays a pass into the box, but Yehvann Diouf reacts well to snuff out the attack.
63' The ball is behind the touchline and Lens will take a throw-in.
61' Wesley Said (Lens) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Yehvann Diouf as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
57' 2 - 0 Odsonne Edouard (Lens) leaps high to meet a deep cross and gives the goalkeeper no chance with a bullet header into the middle of the net.
56' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Florian Thauvin (Lens) but poses no threat.
53' Morgan Sanson (Nice) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
53' Antoine Mendy (Nice) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
51' Antoine Mendy (Nice) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
51' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
50' A pass by Ruben Aguilar (Lens) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
49' Melvin Bard (Nice) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
49' The referee blows his whistle, Nice are awarded a corner kick.

48' Great solo effort by Isak Jansson (Nice) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the top right corner. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' The ball goes out of play and Nice have been awarded a corner kick.

47' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed towards the bottom right corner, but Robin Risser reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
47' Matthieu Udol (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
46' Substitution. Kevin (Nice) in, Charles Vanhoutte out.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' It's a throw-in for Nice.
41' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort narrowly wide of the right post!
41' A player from Lens takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
39' The ball is out of play. Nice will have a throw-in.
37' What a wasted opportunity by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Robin Risser makes a decent save to thwart him.
35' There's an opportunity for Jonathan Clauss (Nice) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
35' A raking crossfield pass from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession. The referee points to the corner flag and Nice will take a corner.
32' Florian Thauvin (Lens) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post.
30' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well over the bar.
30' Willy Delajod interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Samson Baidoo (Lens).

29' Samson Baidoo (Lens) jumps highest to head the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box! A difficult position to score from and the keeper reacts coolly to make a comfortable save.
27' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way wide of the right-hand post.
23' 3:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
20' Willy Delajod blows his whistle after Kojo Peprah (Nice) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
20' Willy Delajod interrupts the game. One of the players from Nice won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
18' Malang Sarr (Lens) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.

17' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
15' 1 - 0 Odsonne Edouard (Lens) reacts well to a deflected cross from Matthieu Udol and places a close-range header beyond the keeper into the right of the goal. 1:0.
15' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lens.
13' Isak Jansson (Nice) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the top left corner. However, Robin Risser anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
10' Yellow card. Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
7' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
6' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yehvann Diouf intercepts the ball.
3' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) serves up a nice cross, but Robin Risser punches the ball away.
2' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
1' The first half has started.
Nice will kick-off.
Willy Delajod is introduced as the referee for today's match.
